messages:
ravi: Spike in Pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1c starting ~12:07 UTC. Tiny jobs (0.05-0.3 GPU) are being evicted right after schedule. Observability shows a tennis-match of evicts/scheduler binds. cc @devin @ana

devin: Seeing it. Events show `gpu-maint:NoSchedule` taint landed on 3 nodes in the c rack at 12:05. That taint wasn't in the planned maintenance list for this AZ. Pending went 28 -> 170 in ~8m.

ana: I rolled out a maintenance template change last night to normalize rack selectors; looks like an overly-broad selector picked up ap-southeast1c. Sorry, my change.

ravi: Pattern = fragmentation cascade: fractional pods scatter, taint triggers evictions, autoscaler spins warm nodes that then get tainted -> tight oscillation and cost burn.

infra-sre: Quick cost delta: extra warm spins ~3 GPU-hrs in last 20m. Warm cold-start ~5m each. If we don't mitigate we'll hit ops burn alert. Recommend removing taints + pausing autoscaler for the region as immediate relief.

devin: Agreed. Short plan: 1) remove taints on affected nodes, 2) pause regional autoscaler, 3) temporarily prefer fractional coalescing in scheduler so tiny pods pack tighter until we fix rollout. I'll run the taint rollback now.

```
kubectl taint node node-apse1c-r03 gpu-maint:NoSchedule- || true
kubectl taint node node-apse1c-r04 gpu-maint:NoSchedule- || true
kubectl taint node node-apse1c-r05 gpu-maint:NoSchedule- || true
# pause autoscaler for ap-southeast1
```

ops-bot: Incident bot: Eviction surge (ap-southeast1c GPU pool) acknowledged by devin at 12:22 UTC. Autoscaler paused for ap-southeast1.

ravi: Untaints applied. Pending started draining within ~70s; eviction rate dropped from ~8/min -> ~0.5/min. Some long-running tiny jobs still bounced once due to in-flight drain.

ana: I'll revert the selector change and add a strict canary to the maintenance orchestration: whitelist rack IDs + canary on single rack, require `pending_gpu <= 12` and `eviction_rate < 1/min` before expanding. Also adding a blacklist: do not taint racks where fractional-pod occupancy > 50%.

leyla: For medium-term: scheduler changes to add a fractional-affinity score and a tiny-pod packing policy would reduce scatter. Also add an alert that pages when warm-pool scale >1.5x baseline for >10m (cost-hedge).

infra-sre: I'll draft a runbook: rollback-taint -> pause-autoscaler -> apply-scheduler-coalesce -> safe-reapply-with-canary. Include cost estimates and an ops checklist.

devin: Leaving autoscaler paused for 20m while we verify steady-state. If evictions spike again i'll re-escalate.

ravi: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: ana fixes rollout template + canary, eng-platform RFC for fractional packing, infra-sre adds cost alert and runbook.

ops-bot: Alert cleared: Eviction rate normalized. Incident logged as 2026-03-23-apse1c-frag-coalesce-rollback. :white_check_mark:
